title: Best Black Friday cycling deals 2026
content:
Cyclist
Best Black Friday cycling deals 2026

Once November rolls around, the Black Friday deals start. This month is a great time to refresh your cycling inventory and replace items that have seen better days after another summer of riding. It’s also an opportunity to upgrade your setup so that you’re ready for a great year of cycling in 2027.

Finding the best Black Friday deals can be a chore, but here at Cyclist we’ve done the hard work for you, searching out the bargains that we’d choose ourselves in the pre-Christmas sales.

Read on for our pick of the 2026 Black Friday deals.

Hunt 44_46 Aerodynamicist wheelset

Was £899, now £539.40 at Hunt Wheels

The Aerodynamicist range is Hunt’s mid-priced wheelset and available in a range of depths, all with 25% off this Black Friday. The Hunt 44_46 Aerodynamicist is the middle depth option and carries over tech from the pricier Limitless wheelsets. With hooked beads, there’s wide tyre compatibility, while Hunt points out that the 22mm internal width allows owners to fit tyres from 25mm up. At under 1,350g for the steel spoked wheels, it helps keep the weight down too.

Cyclist staff writer Laurence Kilpatrick was impressed by the carbon spoked version of the wheels when he reviewed them earlier this year, rating them great value.

We have a whole range of Hunt deals on our dedicated Hunt Black Friday sale page. Hunt says that its most popular deals are already selling out though, so if you have your eye on a wheel upgrade, you might want to act fast.

Scott Shield Light Sensitive Sunglasses

Were £110, now £77 at Scott Sports

Scott’s Black Friday deals include these large lens Shield photochromic sunglasses, available either with a black or white frame. They feature Scott’s gold chrome mirrored lens, which darkens from Cat 1 to Cat 3, so they’ll handle the typical range of light conditions across different seasons. Single tint Shields are discounted as well.

There’s a whole range of other discounts in Scott’s Black Friday sale, from clothing to Syncros Capital wheels. With the brand’s broad range of sports, there are discounts on trail running and ski kit too.

Le Col Hors Categorie Summer Jersey

Was £165, now £99 at Le Col

Le Col’s Black Friday sale includes this top spec Hors Categorie summer jersey. Designed for endurance riders, the fit is a little more relaxed, while features such as a taped neck and embroidered logos add a touch of class and UPF 50+ sun protection should see you through the longest, sunniest summer rides.

Currently available in saffron only, the Hors Categorie summer jersey is part of a wide range of Le Col summer and winter kit on offer, with Le Col Cycling Club members offered early access to the pick of the deals.

Specialized S-Works Aethos 2

Was £11,499, now £8,999 at Sigma Sports

Sigma Sports has discounts on a wide range of road and gravel bikes including the Cervelo S5 and this top spec S-Works Aethos 2 in a range of sizes. Lower Aethos 2 specs are discounted too, although in a more limited range of sizes.

Laurence Kilpatrick rated the S-Works Aethos 2 when he reviewed the bike, not least its 6kg weight in size 56.

Sigma Sports has Black Friday deals on a wide range of clothing, components and accessories too, so chances are that if you’re looking for something specific, Sigma will be offering a Black Friday discount.

Ribble Ultra-Grit Force XPLR AXS

Was £4,449, now £3,999 at Ribble Cycles

Ribble’s Black Friday deals change each week, so if you’re looking for a new gravel race bike, now’s your chance. The Ultra-Grit is ridden by the Ribble Outliers pro race team and features aero tube profiles, a one-piece cockpit and in-frame storage. In this spec, it’s kitted out with SRAM’s 13-speed Force XPLR AXS groupset and Vision SC45 wheels. The frame is suspension fork-compatible and you can upgrade to a RockShox Rudy Ultimate XPLR fork, as well as Zipp 303 XPLR SW wheels in Ribble’s bike builder.

Ribble’s Black Friday deals extend to a wide range of its other road and gravel bikes too and Ribble guarantees that, should the price drop later in the Black Friday sale, it will refund the difference.

Garmin Rally XC200 SPD dual-sided power meter

Was £959.99, now £599.99 at Tredz

The Garmin Rally power meter pedals are discounted at Tredz, offering you dual-sided power measurement for Shimano SPD gravel cleats for not much more than the list price of the single sided power meter. They have swappable bodies, so you can change to an SPD-SL or Look Keo power meter for the price of the upgrade kit.

Tredz has over 1,000 products discounted for Black Friday, including Garmin smartwatches and cycling computers and Garmin Tacx smart trainers, so it’s a great place to browse for your replacements and upgrades.

Castelli Sorpasso Pro Bibtights

Were £220, now £176 at Castelli

Not technically a Black Friday sale, as it finishes on 16th November, but Castelli has discounts on its cold weather essentials, so you can gear up with its jackets, base layers, socks and other cold weather gear for both men and women riders.

The Sorpasso Pro bib tights are Castelli’s top spec winter legwear, with its Progetto X2 Air seat pad, zipperless ankles and lay-flat bibs, as well as the reflectives to keep you safer on your winter rides.

Tacx Neo 2T smart trainer

Was £860, now £689 at Balfe’s Bikes

Tacx’s high tech Neo 2T trainer is discounted at Balfe’s Bikes for Black Friday and is available with either a conventional 11-speed cassette or Zwift Cog and Click for the same price. With 2200 watts resistance, it’s plenty powerful enough, it folds away neatly and can mimic a 25% incline. It’s quiet too, that is unless you want to simulate riding cobbles in preparation for an early season Belgian sportive.

It’s one of a wide range of cycling equipment and bikes discounted in Balfe’s Bikes’ Black Friday sale, including turbo trainers and indoor bikes from Elite, Wahoo and Wattbike.

Muc-Off Pressure Washer Starter Kit

Was £120, now £84.99 at Decathlon

If washing down your bike after a winter ride feels a chore, Muc-Off’s pressure washer can speed things up. It comes with a range of lances, including one that allows you to attach a bottle of Muc-Off’s bike cleaner and spray your bike with grime-busting foam, making bike cleaning much more fun.

Decathlon has a tasty discount on the Muc-Off Pressure Washer Starter Kit, which comes with all the lances you could need and is housed in a Muc-Off branded dry bag, making it easy to carry around. There’s a range of other cycling equipment and bikes in Decathlon’s Black Friday sale too.
